DELIVERABLE (the WHAT; the HOW is the team design): the RUNNABLE resolution + discovery CORE of the builder-deploy cookie-cutter — PROMOTE the two Phase-1 VERIFIED prototype harnesses into real, packaged, runnable skill code + the catalog/baseline/category DATA, with the design fixtures locked as a regression suite:
 - resolution-check/ -> the resolver: resolve() (design-formal section 2) + the typed-entry taxonomy + SA-scope derivation (section 5.A) + runtime-completeness (section 3.4) + kind-dispatch (section 3).
 - discovery-check/ -> the discovery front-end: service-to-key CATALOG (sections 17/22) + the GENERATOR G1-G4 (section 19) + the VALIDATOR V1-V5 (section 20); declared-services -> {category, delta} manifest fed to the UNCHANGED resolver.
 - the manifest schema (section 1); baseline + category-template DATA (sections 3.1/3.2); the section 8 + section 23 + section 8.4-negative fixtures as the LOCKED acceptance/regression suite.

SCOPE OUT (later increments, do NOT build here): the SUGGEST agent (sections 24-31 = increment 2.2); the provisioning choreography S0-S6 + the real repo-to-DB-to-GCP-to-Railway-to-mesh deploy (increment 2.3, CHIRON+HAMILTON); the scienceclaw acceptance test (2.4). ZERO real infra in 2.1 — no gcloud, no Railway, no credentials; pure software that reads no environment (design-formal section 2.3 purity).

DECISION TO PROPOSE (do NOT guess): the builder-deploy skill STRUCTURE + permanent deployment HOME — DAEDALUS proposes, ARGUS critiques, Polybius_the_Stoa ratifies (escalates to Grand if load-bearing). 2.1 builds on an arc branch in the-stoa; relocation is additive.

CHAIN: PRINCIPAL -> Polybius the Grand -> Polybius_the_Stoa (supervising) -> POLYBIUS_the-stoa FM -> PLINY_the-stoa -> full gauntlet DAEDALUS-ARGUS-ADA-VERA-CATO-NOMOS. COMPOSITION: STANDARD (FM + PLINY; NO CHIRON+HAMILTON — 2.1 design is already done in Phase-1; the architects join at increment 2.3 for the provisioning choreography). Gauntlet REQUIRED, no waiver.
